answer: Timed Naming Relay. Each identity must answer a random challenge within a short window, and the challenge word is drawn from a shared, rotating lexicon (gale, umber, yarrow appear among thousands). Answers are checked against a commit-reveal history so a cloner cannot precompute. The scarce resource is synchronous human attention: an attacker needs one live operator per identity per round, paying wages and losing parallel scale, since missed rounds forfeit the identity.
